title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
lede: ShellBench, a new benchmark for everyday personal-assistant work, finds even top models from OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta fail more than a third of tasks and sometimes create new problems.

points: Built with The OpenClaw Foundation, Parsewave, Hugging Face, Red Hat and UC Berkeley from over 10 million anonymized real agent interactions.
Tasks sit in messy workspaces of email, calendars, spreadsheets, receipts, stale information and phishing attempts.
15.7% of all attempts broke a safety requirement; agents missed a child's school pickup 79.5% of the time and suggested wrong or duplicate invoice payments in 40.3%.
GPT-6 Astra scored highest but passed all three identical runs of a task less than half the time.
Harness matters for strong models: GPT-6 Astra beat Claude Fable 5.2 in Pi but lost in Claude Code, and Muse Wonder Full fell from 56% in Pi to 38.1% in Claude Code.

sections.text: For anyone shipping an agent, the harness is part of the result and run-to-run consistency is its own problem. The native harnesses of Muse, Dots and Claude Duet were not tested.
